name: What is the typical process for a handrail repair service?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical process for a handrail repair service?

acceptedAnswer.text: The handrail repair process begins with an initial inspection to assess the damage and determine the best course of action. Following this, we provide a detailed estimate. Once approved, we prepare the work area, procure necessary materials, and perform the repairs, which may include tightening, welding, replacing sections, or restoring finishes. We conclude with a final inspection to ensure the handrail meets safety standards and client satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Our repair process involves inspection, estimate, material procurement, repair execution, and a final safety inspection.
